location.context_description: Opposite Jiantan MRT station, adjacent to Shilin Night Market

urban_roles: Node on cultural axis linking Science Museum, Astronomical Museum, Yuanshan, National Palace Museum
Extension of night-market street life into a public theater machine

massing.main_cube: Central cubic volume consolidating stages, backstages and support spaces
massing.theater_volumes: Three auditoria protruding from the cube, forming multiple 'fronts'
massing.ground_plaza: Lifted volume creates plaza under the cube as extension of street

theaters.type: Large theatre, non-shoebox, folded seating bowl
relations: Can be combined with Multiform/Blue Box to form Super Theater

theaters.name_zh: 球形劇場（鏡框式中劇場）
theaters.type: Spherical auditorium with inner and outer shells, proscenium formed at intersection with cube
relations: Shares backstage and support spaces via cube

theaters.name_zh: 藍盒劇場（多形式中劇場）
relations: Can be combined with Grand Theater as Super Theater

super_theater.description: Massive factory-like environment formed by coupling Grand Theater and Multiform Theatre

typology.批判對象: Standard package of 2000-seat auditorium + 1500-seat theatre + black box with conservative 19th-century internal layouts
strategies: Experimentation in internal workings rather than iconic shell
Consolidation of back-of-house into cube to allow coupling/decoupling of stages
Use of spherical and box typologies to generate new proscenium conditions

city_interface: Street extends into the building under the lifted cube
Plaza works as additional stage for public gatherings

public_loop.description: Trajectory through typically hidden theatre infrastructure and production spaces, open even to visitors without tickets

finance_governance.client: Department of Cultural Affairs, Taipei City Government
